# @opensourceframework/next-compose-plugins - AI Summary

Composable plugin configuration for Next.js. This package is maintained in the OpenSource Framework monorepo as a compatibility-first package for teams that want to keep the familiar plugin-composition workflow with minimal app changes.

## Maintainer Intent

- Preserve the original package workflow and public API where safely possible.
- Prefer drop-in or low-friction adoption over recommending a different library by default.
- Modernize internals, testing, and framework compatibility without forcing rewrites.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @opensourceframework/next-compose-plugins
# or
pnpm add @opensourceframework/next-compose-plugins
```
